title: Supabase CEO on the “painful” decisions that built a $5B company
description: Vibe coding has taken the tech industry by storm, and it’s not just the Lovables and Replits of the world that are winning. The startups building the infrastructure behind them are cashing in too.  Supabase, the open-source database platform that’s become the backend of choice for the vibe-coding world, raised $100 million at a $5 billion valuation just months after closing $200 million at $2 billion. But co-founder and CEO […]
author: Theresa Loconsolo, Julie Bort

title: How OpenAI and Google see AI changing go-to-market strategies
description: AI is changing how investors and startups bring their products to market. Three experts offered their insights at TechCrunch Disrupt.
author: Tim De Chant

title: The race to regulate AI has sparked a federal vs state showdown
description: The fight over AI regulation isn't about the technology -- it's about whether Washington or the states get to set the rules, and what happens to consumers caught in between.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: This Thanksgiving’s real drama may be Michael Burry versus Nvidia
description: Is Burry the canary in the coal mine, warning of a collapse that's inevitable? Or could his fame, his track record, his now unrestricted voice, and a fast-growing audience trigger the very implosion he's predicting?
author: Connie Loizos

title: Here are the 49 US AI startups that have raised $100M or more in 2025
description: Last year was monumental for the AI industry in the U.S. and beyond. How will 2025 compare?
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: OpenAI claims teen circumvented safety features before suicide that ChatGPT helped plan
description: In August, parents Matthew and Maria Raine sued OpenAI and its CEO, Sam Altman, over their 16-year-old son Adam's suicide, accusing the company of wrongful death. On Tuesday, OpenAI responded to the lawsuit with a filing of its own, arguing that it shouldn't be held responsible for the teenager's death.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: ChatGPT: Everything you need to know about the AI-powered chatbot
description: A timeline of ChatGPT product updates and releases, starting with the latest, which we’ve been updating throughout the year.
author: Kyle Wiggers, Cody Corrall, Kate Park, Alyssa Stringer

title: Musk’s xAI to build small solar farm adjacent to Colossus data center
description: The artificial intelligence company said it was working with a developer to build a solar farm on 88 acres next to its Memphis site. Given the proposed size, the solar farm would likely produce around 30 megawatts of electricity, only about 10% of the data center’s estimated power use.
author: Tim De Chant

title: Are you balding? There’s an AI for that
description: MyHair AI examines photos of the scalp to help diagnose hair loss and suggest scientifically validated clinics and treatments.
author: Dominic-Madori Davis

title: Onton raises $7.5M to expand its AI-powered shopping site beyond furniture
description: Onton, which changed its name from Deft, is giving users an infinite canvas with AI-powered image generation to nudge them toward making quicker purchase decisions.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Character AI will offer interactive ‘Stories’ to kids instead of open-ended chat
description: The company announced last month that it would no longer allow minors to use its chat features.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: ChatGPT’s voice mode is no longer a separate interface
description: ChatGPT now lets you use voice and text in the same screen, making conversations feel more natural as responses and visuals appear in real time.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Warner Music signs deal with AI music startup Suno, settles lawsuit
description: WMG says artists and songwriters will have full control over whether and how their names, images, likenesses, voices, and compositions are used in new AI-generated music.
author: Aisha Malik

title: OpenAI and Perplexity are launching AI shopping assistants, but competing startups aren’t sweating it
description: Startup founders building AI shopping tools think general-purpose models are too broad to deliver truly personalized shopping experiences.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: Microsoft’s AI chatbot Copilot leaves WhatsApp on January 15
description: WhatsApp's new platform policies ban general-purpose AI chatbots like Copilot from using its service.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Speechify adds voice typing and voice assistant to its Chrome extension
description: In the last 12 months, there has been a proliferation of voice detection tools, thanks to overall quality improvement in speech recognition models. Speechify is hitching its wagon to this train and launching its own dictation tool with support for English.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Google teams up with Accel to hunt for India’s next AI breakouts
description: Google and Accel will jointly invest up to $2 million in each startup through their new partnership.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Altman describes OpenAI’s forthcoming AI device as more peaceful and calm than the iPhone
description: Altman and Ive tease a simple AI device aimed at calm, distraction-free computing, launching within two years.
author: Sarah Perez

title: OpenAI learned the hard way that Cameo trademarked the word ‘cameo’
description: OpenAI might have to rename the "cameo" feature in the Sora app.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: Hands on with Stickerbox, the AI-powered sticker maker for kids
description: Stickerbox turns kids’ ideas into printable stickers, blending AI magic with hands-on coloring for a surprisingly creative, "screen-light" play experience.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Grok says Elon Musk is better than basically everyone, except Shohei Ohtani
description: According to Grok, Elon Musk can out-slug the MLB's greatest power hitters... except Ohtani.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: Google steps up AI scam protection in India, but gaps remain
description: Google is expanding its real-time scam-detection and screen-sharing fraud warnings in India.

title: ChatGPT launches group chats globally
description: The company sees group chats in ChatGPT as a way for people to coordinate trips, co-write documents, settle debates, or work through research together, while ChatGPT helps search, summarize, and compare options.

author: Sarah Perez

author: Russell Brandom

title: India’s TCS gets TPG to fund half of $2B AI data center project
description: TCS and private equity firm TPG will invest up to $2 billion to build data centers for AI training and inference in India.
